subject.title: ci(mantis): add web UI chat proof lane

question: Is the hosted proof-shim run sufficient to accept the new Mantis web UI chat workflow before the literal workflow file is default-registered on main?
rationale: The change adds a secret-backed Mantis publishing boundary and GitHub workflow command path; automation can verify the code and proof artifacts, but maintainer intent is needed to accept that remaining registration boundary.

options.title: Accept the hosted proof and land
options.body: Treat run 28804452130 as sufficient coverage for authorization, candidate validation, Control UI proof, artifact upload, and Mantis App/R2 publishing, with any literal workflow-dispatch smoke happening after merge.

options.title: Require more pre-merge proof
options.body: Ask for another maintainer-owned proof path before merge if the proof-shim is not enough to cover the default-registration boundary.

options.title: Pause the lane
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw core to own this Mantis web UI chat proof workflow yet.

recommendation.title: Accept the hosted proof and land
recommendation.body: Treat run 28804452130 as sufficient coverage for authorization, candidate validation, Control UI proof, artifact upload, and Mantis App/R2 publishing, with any literal workflow-dispatch smoke happening after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on Mantis evidence publishing and adjacent Control UI workflow changes.
